name: beacon_lists_server
description: A LAN server's beacon (GHB1, protocol version, WebSocket port, open parties, name) handed to the listener lists the server under Nearby in the Join panel, keyed by its address and port; a beacon of another protocol version, or not a beacon at all, is not listed; a server silent for 3 s drops off.

steps.msg: a beacon of this protocol version lists its server
a mismatched version is not listed

steps.assert: not Session.beacon.inject('GHB2 not a beacon'.to_ascii_buffer(), '192.168.1.22') and not Session.beacon.inject(PackedByteArray([71, 72, 66, 49, 0, 1]), '192.168.1.23')
steps.msg: nor is a datagram that is not a beacon
Nearby lists them by name, the default port left out

steps.assert: screen_has("Sascha's server") and screen_has('2 parties') and screen_has('192.168.1.30:9000') and not screen_has('Newer server')
steps.msg: the Join panel shows them, not the mismatched one
after 3 s of silence the Attic drops off; the server still calling stays

steps.assert: not node('Nearby').visible and node('WebLine').visible and node('WebLine').text.begins_with('LAN games need the desktop version.')
steps.msg: the browser plays online only: one line instead of Nearby
